annotations.title: Check a 3D generation or model job

description: Wait for a task_id and return its result: the finished model in the 3D viewer, or the report / files of a print, Low Poly, rig, face or craft job. Waits up to wait_seconds; call again while it is still running. Free: it never starts or pays for anything.

task_id.description: task_id returned by generate_from_image, generate_from_text or a model job tool

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result before answering (0–50 s, default 25)

name: get_task
